Company Description: Citadel is a global financial institution operating one of the world’s largest and most successful hedge funds, alongside a leading market-making business through Citadel Securities. Name: 2027 Summer Analyst Programme
Company Description: Goldman Sachs is one of the world’s most prestigious investment banks and financial institutions, offering a wide range of services in investment banking, asset management, global markets, consumer banking, and wealth management. It also operates Marcus, its consumer banking platform, and has expanded into transaction banking and alternative investments. Known for its elite talent, risk culture, and thought leadership, Goldman Sachs is also increasingly focused on sustainability, digital finance, and private capital markets. It plays a key role in shaping financial innovation and global capital flows.
